title: When the Ember Wakes
author: T. M. Reyes
blurb: Silas Galloway, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
